title: AI Agents for Credit Unions: An NCUA-Aligned Deployment Guide
summary: A practical guide for credit unions deploying AI voice and chat agents — covering NCUA expectations, Reg E, share-draft language, member experience, and the small-shop realities of CU technology stacks.
